title: agent-relay config
description: ~/.config/agent-relay/config.json. Every key is optional except channel and user; missing keys use these defaults.

channel.title: Slack channel
channel.description: Conversation ID of the private channel the bot reads and posts in. `agent-relay config set channel` also accepts the channel link.

channels.title: More channels
channels.description: Other conversation IDs to read too. Agents answer in the channel you wrote in, and never read or post anywhere not listed here or in channel.

user.title: Your Slack member ID
user.description: Only messages written by this user are read. Slack profile → ⋮ → Copy member ID.

trigger.title: Trigger
trigger.description: Messages starting with this go to the agents, e.g. ! or :zap:. Write <trigger><name> to talk to one.

icon.title: Default icon
icon.description: Emoji in front of agent posts, unless the dispatcher or workers set their own.

reply_in_thread.title: Answer in a thread
reply_in_thread.description: Answer a message written in the channel in a thread under it. Off answers in the channel.

thinking.title: While thinking
thinking.description: Posted as soon as the dispatcher gets your message, then replaced by its answer, e.g. :loading-2:. Empty posts nothing until the answer.

show_label.title: Show name tag
show_label.description: Put [name] after the icon in each post.

slack.title: Slack login
slack.description: Files holding your own Slack token, and its d cookie for a browser (xoxc-) token. Posts are sent as you, and serve checks the token belongs to user.

cookie_file.title: Cookie file
cookie_file.description: Needed for xoxc- tokens. Empty for xoxp- tokens.

jira_url.title: Jira site
jira_url.description: Base address for ticket links, e.g. https://acme.atlassian.net. Empty turns Jira links off.

jira_projects.title: Jira projects to link
jira_projects.description: Keys like ADE-123 from these projects become links in every post.

dispatcher.title: Dispatcher
dispatcher.description: Answers trigger messages in a fresh session each time and starts workers.

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: Emoji in front of its posts. Empty uses the default icon.

models.title: Model per runner
models.description: The one for dispatcher.runner is used, in that runner's own format, e.g. github-copilot/claude-haiku-5.5 for opencode. Empty uses the runner's own default model.

local_agent.title: OpenCode agent for local models
local_agent.description: Used instead of OpenCode's default agent when the dispatcher runs an ollama/ model, e.g. a slim agent in workdir/.opencode/opencode.json. Empty uses the default agent.

auto.title: Skip permission prompts
auto.description: opencode --auto or claude --dangerously-skip-permissions. pi never asks.

memory_lines.title: Memory size
memory_lines.description: Line limit the dispatcher keeps MEMORY.md under.

worker.title: Workers
worker.description: Agents started in a repo for real work. Each keeps its own session.

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: Emoji in front of worker posts. Empty uses the default icon.

connectors.title: Connectors
connectors.description: Tools the agents reach through their own CLIs. `agent-relay connectors` runs each check with bash -o pipefail: exit 0 means signed in, and the first line it prints is shown. An empty check turns a connector off.

github.title: GitHub
github.check: gh auth status --active 2>&1 | grep -m1 -E 'Logged in|Failed|not logged'

datadog.title: Datadog
datadog.check: pup auth status 2>/dev/null | jq -er 'select(.authenticated) | "signed in, token until \(.expires_at)"'

clickhouse.title: ClickHouse
clickhouse.check: gcx datasources list --jq '[.datasources[] | select(.type | test("clickhouse"))] | if length > 0 then "\(length) datasources via Grafana" else error("no ClickHouse datasource in Grafana") end'

claude_settings.title: Extra Claude Code settings
claude_settings.description: Passed with --settings to every claude the relay starts. Use it to let commands through a managed sandbox, e.g. {"sandbox": {"excludedCommands": ["acli *"]}}.

repos.title: Repos
repos.description: Name → folder. Workers start in these folders; the name is also the worker's name.

recap.title: Work recap
recap.description: Scoped work summaries for `!bot recap` and `agent-relay recap`. Only GitHub orgs listed in github_orgs are included; personal repos are never included.

github_orgs.title: GitHub orgs
github_orgs.description: Allowlist of GitHub orgs to include in recaps (PRs, local git repos, and Langfuse sessions). Personal repos are never included.

mood.title: Default mood
mood.description: Summary style when not overridden inline: brief (standup-ready), funny (dry 1-liners), or detailed (tickets, files, reviews, investigations).

repo_roots.title: Extra repo folders
repo_roots.description: Folders scanned for local git repos in addition to repos. Only repos whose remote belongs to recap.github_orgs are included.

langfuse_url.title: Local Langfuse URL
langfuse_url.description: Base URL for local Langfuse (e.g. http://localhost:3000) to include recent agent investigations. Empty turns Langfuse off.
